description:
Kick off a video export of the project. Returns immediately with an export_id;
the export renders in the background and takes ~5 min. Call get_export(export_id,
wait_seconds=55) until status is completed — it then returns download_url (or, for
destination="embed", embed_url). The export also appears in the Exports tab in the editor.

destination:
  • "download" (default) — an mp4 file; get_export returns a time-limited download_url.
  • "embed" — publish the project as an embeddable video player (the same embed the
    editor's Share → Embed creates). The embed URL is permanent: re-publishing after
    edits updates the video behind the SAME URL, so pages and LMS lessons that embed it
    update in place. Use get_embed(project_id) to read the URL and iframe code of an
    already-published project without re-rendering.

Defaults: 1080p / 30fps / no captions / English. Pass overrides only when needed.
`captions` burns subtitles into a download; an embed instead carries captions the
viewer toggles in the player, so `captions` is ignored for destination="embed".

captions.description: Burn subtitles into the video (default false)

destination.description: Where the render goes: "download" (mp4 file, default) or "embed" (publish/update the project's embeddable player; its URL never changes). Publishing an embed needs an editor or admin role.

name: export_project
title: Export project
